samples.title: Thói quen đi bộ
samples.prompt: Your friend has invited you to a neighbourhood walking event. Accept the invitation, explain your travel plans, and ask about preparation while offering help.

samples.summaryVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Nhận lời
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for inviting me to a neighbourhood walking event. I would love to come. I have been interested in walking as a daily habit for some time, so I am glad we will have a chance to explore it together.
paragraphs.noteVi: Cảm ơn và trả lời trực tiếp lời mời.

paragraphs.label: Đi lại
paragraphs.text: I can meet you at the park entrance on Saturday at nine in the morning. I am planning to take the bus and arrive ten minutes early. If the time or meeting point changes, please send me a message before I leave home.
paragraphs.noteVi: Lịch hẹn và phương án cập nhật.

paragraphs.label: Chuẩn bị và hỗ trợ
paragraphs.text: I understand that we will explore a short local route and note useful improvements. I can bring comfortable walking shoes, but could you let me know if anything else is needed? One useful point is that people can include gentle movement in ordinary routines. For example, a resident can walk to a nearby market instead of taking a motorbike for a very short trip. I would also be happy to help arrange the seats or hand out materials before the session begins.
paragraphs.noteVi: Hỏi rõ chuẩn bị, nối với nội dung sự kiện.

paragraphs.label: Kết thư
paragraphs.text:
Thanks again for thinking of me. It will be lovely to spend time together and learn something practical. Let me know whether you would like me to arrive earlier to help.

Best wishes,
Minh
paragraphs.noteVi: Thể hiện thiện chí và chốt.
